strips.why: flicker: patches change and change straight back on 20% of the shot's frames (7 cells here)

summary: Mostly clean. Ceiling and sky flicker in the confetti strips, plus a fade-in at the start of image 2 and a pose snap at 130.73.

faults.what: Ceiling/sky patch alternates between blue sky with cloud and dark brown/maroon from tile to tile (130.36 dark, 130.46 sky, 130.53 dark, 130.56 sky, 130.63 dark). Large part of the frame flickers.
faults.fix: Fix the ceiling/sky material or lighting so it doesn't swap. Check z-fighting or a toggled layer on the ceiling mesh.

faults.what: Ceiling flips between pale sky and flat brown across tiles (129.19 and 129.29 brown, 129.22, 129.26 and 129.32 sky). The brown wedge edge changes between tiles.
Pose snaps in one frame from the arms-out pointing pose (130.69) to a different wide-stance pose with arm crossing the body (130.73). No in-between frames. Camera framing and head height jump too.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 frames of transition or blend, or hide the snap with the cut/fade.

faults.what: Shot opens on a heavily washed-out frame that fades up over about 6 frames. The fade is non-linear and the brightness is uneven between tiles (129.26 to 129.29 darkens).
faults.fix: Use a smooth linear fade or cut straight into the shot.

faults.what: Confetti is large, flat and unshaded, and it crosses in front of both figures. It flickers in position between tiles.
faults.fix: Light the confetti and shrink it, or move it away from the figures.
